build_hiplot_package: build the hiplot python package using setup.py with setuptools and distutils
install_hiplot_from_source: install the hiplot package from source using pip install with main and dev requirements
run_hiplot_server: run the hiplot interactive plotting server via the hiplot console script entry point
run_hiplot_render: run the hiplot-render CLI tool to render high dimensional plots from data
review_setup_requirements: review the setup.py requirements parsing that filters git-based deps from requirements files
